record.title: Publish a synthetic sealed-review walkthrough with known inputs
record.intent: Let contributors reproduce the composed offline result without private instrument evidence.
requirements: Provide a tiny independently identified synthetic capture transcript statistics and profile with a preserved manifest pin and project-relative provenance.
Document the existing public CLI sequence from a fresh copy with outputs outside the sealed tree and no network device or recorder activity.
Demonstrate accepted composition and distinguish post-seal mutation from separately resealed transcript disagreement using retained failure reports.
Exercise the exact public example through source and installed distributions and include relevant documentation and fixture paths in CI triggers.
acceptance: A contributor can reproduce the expected positive and negative results using only tracked inputs and the locked workspace.
